text:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: PAGED: embeddings-queue-backlog > 5m (service=embeddings-worker) -- incident INC-2026-79. Pager: primary=Alex, secondary=Maria. Auto-escalation in 10m if not acked.

Alex: Acked. I'm primary. I'll grab initial triage, thanks.

Maria: I can standby as secondary. Quick note — this coincided with a batch job at 02:12 that spiked kv-cache misses.

Alex: Confirming alerts: backpressure on embeddings-worker, 5+ minute queue latency across 3 pods, error rate for downstream router up to 4%.

Alex: Initial checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embeddings` shows 3/3 Running but CPU ~90% on pod-2.

Alex: tailing logs:```
kubectl -n inference logs embeddings-worker-2 -c worker --since=5m
... 2026-03-13T02:15:13Z WARN kvcache miss for prefix abc123
... 2026-03-13T02:15:14Z ERROR retrying request to model-variant-quant; attempt=3
```

Maria: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings_backlog (see "fast scale + fallback" section). Steps I've started: 1) increase replica count for embeddings-worker from 3 -> 6 (temp), 2) enable routing fallback to quantized-variant-2 for non-critical tenants.

Alex: Scaling command executed: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/embeddings-worker --replicas=6` at 02:18. Pods starting.

Priya: Noted a customer-impact banner in status: small fraction of autocomplete features degraded for some customers. I've set customers in the affected cohort to degraded status and notified CS on rotation.

Maria: I flipped routing rule for low-priority tenants to quantized-variant-2 at 02:21 using routemgr: `routemgr set-rule --service embeddings --cohort low-priority --target quantized-variant-2 --ttl 30m` — confirmed via `/api/routes?service=embeddings`. Should reduce load.

Alex: Observability: token processing latency slice shows median back to ~250ms, p95 down from 6.2s to 1.2s after scale and fallback. Alerting still active for the high-latency tail.

OpsBot: System message: deployment embeddings-worker scaled to 6 replicas (autoscaler override) at 02:19.

Sam: I'm about to take over at 03:00 for the next 4h window. Any outstanding items I should track?

Alex: Handoff summary for Sam — ACTIVE ITEMS: 1) High-latency tail alert (still firing p99>4s). 2) Watch pods for OOM/saturation (new pods may ramp). 3) Confirm routemgr fallback remains in place and doesn't cascade to high-priority tenants.

Alex: Mitigations in progress: replicas increased -> 6 (done). Routing fallback -> active for low-priority cohorts (done). Prefix KV-cache warmup scheduled: I'm running a warmup job `scripts/warmup_prefixes.sh --cohorts low-priority` to refill caches — started at 02:25, progress ~40%.

Maria: Runbook pointers for Sam: - embeddings_backlog runbook (section "scale + fallback") - emergency rollback: `routemgr revert --rule <id>` - cache warmup job: `scripts/warmup_prefixes.sh` (monitor logs in /var/log/warmup).

Alex: Known coverage gap: between 05:00-06:00 UTC we have only on-call coverage with night SRE (no dedicated eng rotations). If the p99 doesn't stabilize by then escalate to Eng Leads and consider capacity burst to Dedicated pool.

Sam: Got it. I'll be primary at 03:00. I'll keep an eye for repeat errors from model-variant-quant and the warmup completion. If p99 > 3s for 15m I'll trigger canary rollback to a smaller seq-len config (runbook has command).

Priya: I've sent a short customer impact note to CS and created a single-thread incident update for affected tenants. Will update once warmup completes.

Alex: Leaving detailed handoff: active_alerts=embeddings-queue-backlog (p95>1s, p99>4s), mitigations=[scale->6, fallback->low-priority, warmup job running], commands_executed=[kubectl scale, routemgr set-rule], dashboards to watch=[/dashboards/embeddings/latency, /dashboards/embeddings/queue-depth].

Alex: Passing primary to Sam at 03:00. I'll remain reachable for context until 04:00.

Sam: Taking primary at 03:00. Acknowledge.

OpsBot: Note: this thread will be used for handoff. Incident still OPEN: INC-2026-79.

Alex: One-liner for next shift: if p99 remains elevated after warmup completes, consider temporary traffic shed for non-SLAs or burst to dedicated pool; contact infra on-call before major capacity changes.

Sam: Thanks — I'll update this thread every 15m until resolved or handed off.

Priya: I'll post a customer-facing update after warmup completes or if we see regression.

Maria: Adding: if you need rapid rollback of routemgr, ID is `rule-emb-fallback-20260313-01`.

Sam: Noted. Starting 15m cadence checks now.

Alex: Handoff complete.
